video_title: Training Camp Media Availability (9/30/26) | LA Clippers

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue acknowledges the Clippers are a smaller team and must focus on physicality to rebound.
quotes.excerpt: We are a smaller team. We are definitely a smaller team in height and size.
quotes.quote: We are a smaller team. We are definitely a smaller team in height and size. We have to be tough minded and tough every night without rebounding the basketball every night and we have to bring a physicality to rebound the ball.
quotes.social_post: Tyronn Lue says the Clippers are a smaller team this season and must focus on physical play to win the rebounding battle.

quotes.speaker: Kai Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Kai Jones believes the Clippers have the right mindset to overcome underdog status.
quotes.excerpt: Everybody say that we underdog in everything right now but we have the mindset
quotes.quote: Everybody say that we underdog in everything right now but we have the mindset that we know what we can do. I expect big things. He has been playing very comfortable coming off pick and roll, getting downhill, making plays for others and himself. He has just been playing tremendous on offense.
quotes.social_post: Kai Jones says the Clippers have the right mindset to overcome their underdog status this season.

quotes.speaker: Terance Mann
quotes.summary_phrase: Terance Mann praises Keaton for his high basketball IQ and fast processing speed.
quotes.excerpt: One thing I learned about Keaton that he processes things very fast.
quotes.quote: One thing I learned about Keaton that he processes things very fast. He has a very high IQ and he has been playing really well since I have landed in California and even in training camp yesterday I thought he played well.
quotes.social_post: Terance Mann says Keaton has a very high basketball IQ and processes the game very fast.
